caption:
your watch has been writing this down the whole time

#applewatch #wearabletech #healthdata

slides.text:
Your watch has been
recording this for two years

Every night you slept

Every one you didn't

Every session, and how hard
your heart found it
It is all still in there

The question was never
whether you had the data

slides.heading: Two years of data, one useful sentence
slides.body: SOMA reads what your watch already recorded and turns it into today's session and today's food
